title: Decentralize single-use workspace dependencies
description: Move dependencies used by only one crate (rusqlite, axum, tokio, rustls, ulid) from workspace.dependencies to their respective Cargo.toml files. Keep serde, serde_json, and internal crates centralized since they are widely shared. This reduces lock-step version coupling and improves build performance for development. Trade-off: lose one-line version management for those crates, but gain clarity on what each binary really depends on.
notes: opinion: no engineering basis — workspace.dependencies centralization for single-use crates is a valid and common monorepo pattern. No bug risk either way; this is stylistic organization preference only.
